title: How Long Does BBL Recovery Take? Week-by-Week Timeline
meta_description: Most BBL patients return to desk work in 10-14 days, sit normally at about 8 weeks and see final results in 3-6 months. The week-by-week timeline, sourced.
excerpt: Plan on about two weeks off work, eight weeks of protecting your buttocks and three to six months to see your final shape. Here's the BBL recovery timeline week by week, with figures from Cleveland Clinic, The Aesthetic Society and ASPS.
quick_answer:
How long does BBL recovery take?

Plan on about two weeks off work, eight weeks of protecting your buttocks and three to six months to see your final shape. Cleveland Clinic says not to sit or lie on your buttocks for at least two weeks and puts full recovery at two to three months, noting that it can take up to six.

images.text_in_image:
BBL recovery timeline
Days 1–5: Rest, short walks at home
Days 6–14: Desk work and driving from about day 10, on a pillow
Weeks 3–6: BBL pillow, about 10 minutes at a time
Weeks 7–8: Exercise again at about 8 weeks, once cleared
Months 2–3: Most feel recovered
Months 3–6: Final shape shows
Your surgeon's instructions come first
Sources: Cleveland Clinic, The Aesthetic Society, ASPS
